cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Carry This with Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to share a burden by framing participation as part of the relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've assigned us this box of letters before the removal van comes. We wrote them together; we're sorting them together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You kept them. I thought you'd want to decide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I haven't approved making me the keeper of all ten years. You may choose what matters beside me, not leave me to choose for both of us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll take the box, but I can't read them today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Postponement granted. Choose a day we'll open it together before you take it. I'm not transferring all the deciding to you either.

reason: Make A grant postponement while refusing unilateral emotional burden in either direction; B offered custody determines the condition of a future joint session.
